genius.notes: Reviewed as the Legacy V1 sUSDC yield share under GENIUS section 2(22). Spark documents USDC deposits routed into the Sky Savings Rate and an increasing share redemption rate. The wrapper has its own scope classification; USDC issuer licenses and parent payment-token classifications do not transfer to the vault share. No GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization is asserted.
